name: auto-claude
description: Finishes a repository's work unattended and live: Claude plans the long-term end state, its milestones and how it deploys; the built-in loop builds each milestone in its own worktree and judges it; auto-claude ships it (push, PR, CI, merge when green), deploys and smoke-checks it, and a watchdog keeps the run moving until the final check passes. With --always-on it does not end there: it stands by with no model turn and wakes for a new cycle when Linear, the live smoke check, the default branch's CI or a labelled GitHub issue gives it work (1.4.0). Once a run's final check passes, the next run toward the same aim plans itself, within daily caps, unless started with --once (1.6.0). Absorbs goal-mode's loop (1.0.0).

ciMode.title: CI mode
ciMode.description: github: push, open a PR, wait for its checks, squash-merge when green. local: run the milestone's check, rebase onto the default branch and push it there. auto: github when gh can see the origin repository

maxRounds.title: Max planning rounds
maxRounds.description: Replans after the queue empties while the final check still fails

maxMerges.title: Max merges per run
maxMerges.description: Stops and reports after this many merges

maxHours.title: Max hours per run
maxHours.description: Stops and reports after this many hours of working time (waiting on :: after: lines is not counted, up to maxWaitHours)

maxWaitHours.title: Max waiting hours per run
maxWaitHours.description: Hours of waiting on :: after: lines (training, cache builds) left out of maxHours

ciPollSec.title: CI poll interval (s)
ciPollSec.description: How often the driver looks at the loop's log and the open PR

ultracode.title: Runs work in ultracode
ultracode.description: The session that owns a run turns on ultracode (/effort ultracode on: standing dynamic workflows) at each run's start, resume or next run. Needs workflows on and a model that supports it. Off: the session's effort is left as it is

continueRuns.title: Runs go on by themselves
continueRuns.description: Once a run's final check passes, the same session plans the next run toward the same aim (not for --once, always-on or --queue runs). Off: a run ends when its final check passes

maxRunsPerDay.title: Max runs started per 24 h
maxRunsPerDay.description: A finished run plans no next one while this many runs of the chain started in the last 24 h

alwaysOn.title: Always on by default
alwaysOn.description: Every /auto-claude start stands by after its final check passes, as with --always-on (--once opts a run out)

healthEveryMin.title: Standby smoke check interval (min)
healthEveryMin.description: While standing by, how often the plan's Smoke check runs; 2 failures in a row queue a repair and wake the run

githubEveryMin.title: Standby GitHub poll interval (min)
githubEveryMin.description: While standing by, how often the default branch's CI runs and labelled issues are read (github CI mode only)

issueLabel.title: GitHub issue label
issueLabel.description: Open issues with this label become queue lines of an always-on run (empty: issues are not read). Only people with triage access can label, so the label is the trust gate

maxMergesPerDay.title: Max merges per 24 h (always on)
maxMergesPerDay.description: An always-on run does not wake while the last 24 h already hold this many merges; maxMerges and maxHours count per cycle
